result.description:
Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

result.description:
Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://janusnet.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies

Applications close 26 July 2026

About the Company

Aggreko Australia Pty Ltd (Aggreko Australia) is a provider of flexible power generation solutions in Australia and the Pacific. It maintains global leadership in the temporary power generation marketplace by offering innovative rental solutions. Aggreko is a major player in the global power market. Aggreko has an established record of working with businesses to improve their outputs, manage power demands and plan for emergencies. Our specialised technology is critical to the operations of several global businesses, and we have continued to rapidly grow across the mining, construction and emergency service sector.

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated Service Technician- Electrical to join our team on a full-time basis. In this role you will be responsible for the following:

Perform comprehensive maintenance on hire fleet assets.
Conduct scheduled servicing for optimal fleet performance.
Execute internal repairs, customer site installations/removals.
Troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and costs.
Ensure fleet livery adheres to company policy and customer expectations.
Maintain adequate material and tool levels.
Maintain basic tooling and stock in service vehicle.
Quality and Customer Service:
Deliver quality workmanship to enhance equipment reliability.
Ensure customer satisfaction with equipment and service.
Maintain and enhance relationships with internal and external customers.
Provide technical support to the Sales Team.
Administrative and Operational:
Carry out electrical repairs and checks per company policy.
Accurately complete required documentation (Prep for Hire/Delivery/Return/Service Order FSL and Spartan Systems).
Manage work hours and complete tasks within deadlines, including potential overtime.
About You

To be successful in obtaining this role, you will have:

Proven experience in a similar role
Relevant trade qualification
Exceptional communication skills.
Strong customer focus.
Ability to work under pressure and make deadlines.
Planning, problem solving and coordination skills.
Ability to work unsupervised at times.
Salary

If successful, you will be paid a base salary of approximately $100,000 per annum.

result.description:
Kimberley Motorcycle Centres are currently recruiting for an experienced and qualified Motorcycle Mechanic to join their team in Broome WA.


The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

- Dismantle engines and repair or replace defective parts, such as magnetos, carburetors, and generators
- Remove cylinder heads, grind valves, and scrape off carbon, and replace defective valves, pistons, cylinders and rings, using hand tools and power tools
- Repair or replace other parts, such as headlights, horns, handlebar controls, gasoline and oil tanks, starters and mufflers
- Repair and adjust motorcycle subassemblies such as forks, transmissions, brakes, and drive chains, according to specifications
- Replace defective parts, using hand tools, arbor presses, flexible power presses, or power tools
- Reassemble and test subassembly units
- Disassemble subassembly units and examine condition, movement or alignment of parts visually or using gauges
 

Skills and Abilities:

- Certificate III in Motorcycle Mechanical Technology or equivalent
- Ideally have a minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Motorcycle Mechanic
- The ability to work in a team environment


Salary range is $70,000 -$85,000  commensurate with experience

Hours: Fulltime

Applications open on 20th July 2026 and closes on 20th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now
